learning_outcomes.text: Students have expanded and advanced knowledge of mathematical techniques for modeling and solving their subject-specific problems.

Students can apply the methods of complex calculation and multidimensional analysis to subject-specific problems. They understand the description and solution of technical problems using ordinary differential equations. They can assess the relevance and consistency of these solutions for applications in electrical engineering/mechatronics.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are specified in the respective valid study regulations.
